# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# First Writing Pass: Planned Versus Actual

> The Awtsmoos reads the vessel after ink has found its place;
> Awtsmoos.com compares intention with the evidence of grace.

## Original Planned Writes

- Repair readiness timing.
- Separate public and repository model paths.
- Anchor chat and launcher optional imports to source-aware URLs.
- Add focused runtime and CompactJS tests.
- Preserve unrelated loot-drop changes.
- Regenerate the compact bundle only after source proofs pass.

## Actual First-Pass Writes

1. `MinimalSharedMeadowReadinessFlow.js` now awaits the real bounded bootstrap settlement and removes the fabricated pending receipt.
2. `RemoteModelCatalog.js` now publishes `/games/mitzvahWorld/assets/models/` while retaining `geelooy/games/mitzvahWorld/assets/models/` for repository evidence.
3. `MultiplayerOptionalUi.js` now computes absolute chat module URLs from `import.meta.url`.
4. `MinimalMeadowOptionalEntries.js` now computes absolute API and mobile module URLs from `import.meta.url`.
5. Three focused ESM test files and one real-entry CompactJS test were written.
6. Every handwritten touched file was read back in full and is 120 lines or fewer.
7. Unrelated loot-drop files were not touched.

## Verification So Far

- Four source syntax checks passed.
- Five focused tests passed with zero failures.
- Real-entry CompactJS compilation and generated-source assertions passed.
- Node emitted only pre-existing typeless-package warnings.

## Remaining Delta

1. Regenerate `mitzvah-world.compact.js` atomically through the canonical compiler.
2. Syntax-check and hash the emitted bundle.
3. Run the broader CompactJS regression suite.
4. Verify public model HTTP response.
5. Reload the public page with cache bypass and inspect readiness, runtime systems, console, and failed resources.
6. Resolve any newly exposed runtime failures.
7. Re-read touched files and emitted contract snippets.
8. Rewrite durable handoff and remaining-work documents from final evidence.

## Next Action

Generate the compact artifact from `launcher/MinimalSharedMeadowPage.js`, then test the emitted scroll before touching documentation.
